title: The family's shared phone
description: The one Android phone the Sengmany family shares, held by Bounmy (J4): a family wallet with a profile per member (Bounmy, Khamla, Somsak) and one VHL QR per member, presented by the VHL Holder. It is the Holder's device, not an actor of its own in either guide.

parts.title: Family wallet
parts.description: The wallet app on the family's phone: a profile per family member, each holding that member's VHL QR, shown when asked (J4.0, J4.1).
